original_ai_output.title_zh: 军方澄清高原州部队与警察人员所谓冲突
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚高原州巴萨地方政府辖区，特别任务部队“持久和平行动”（JTF-OPEP）就近期其部队与尼日利亚警察部队人员之间的遭遇作出澄清，称该遭遇被误解为冲突。此前社交媒体流传军方与警察发生冲突的视频和照片，并据称军方阻止警察追捕罪犯。军方表示，10月20日部队是响应枪击报警而出动，与警方接触时部分人员缺乏配合。相关情况正通过指挥与跨机构渠道核实。

location.raw_text: Bassa Local Government Area (LGA) of Plateau, Jos

key_facts.fact: 特别任务部队“持久和平行动”就部队与警察人员的遭遇作出澄清
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Special Task Force Operation Enduring Peace (JTF-OPEP), has cleared the air on the recent encounter between its troops and personnel of Nigeria Police Force (NPF) in Bassa Local Government Area (LGA) of Plateau.

key_facts.fact: 军方称该遭遇被误解为冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: said that the encounter between the two security agencies was misconstrued to be a clash

key_facts.fact: 社交媒体流传军方与警察所谓冲突的视频和照片
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: videos and photographs of an alleged clash between the military and police personnel recently went viral on the social media

key_facts.fact: 据称军方阻止警察追捕罪犯
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It was alleged that troops had prevented the police personnel from going after some criminals in the area.

key_facts.fact: 军方称10月20日部队响应枪击报警出动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On Oct. 20, troops of our Sector 3, responded to a distress call reporting sporadic gunfire in Mai Farin Moto, Maraban Dere and adjoining communities.

key_facts.fact: 军方称与警方接触时部分人员缺乏配合
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the interaction was characterised by a lack of cooperation from some personnel

uncertainties: 军方与警察之间是否发生冲突尚未证实，军方称被误解
据称军方阻止警察追捕罪犯的说法尚未获独立确认
事件仅由单一来源（尼日利亚通讯社）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
